svg.title: smart-srun
svg.desc: smart-srun (fork): SRun campus login on OpenWrt. Auto-login with reconnects, multiple accounts and scheduled hotspot switching. I fixed radio detection, portal fallback and daemon status. OpenWrt · LuCI. 3 PRs merged upstream.
